headline: A 2022 Senate resolution would have blocked a proposed US weapons sale to Egypt, but the Senate did not take it up.
what_it_does: If adopted, this joint resolution would have prohibited a proposed foreign military sale of certain defense articles and services to the Government of Egypt. The official summary does not list the specific equipment involved. The Senate refused to take up or end debate on the resolution on March 10, 2022, so it did not pass.

who_it_affects.how: It would not have been able to complete the proposed purchase of the listed US defense articles and services.

who_it_affects.group: US defense contractors that would have supplied the equipment
who_it_affects.how: They would not have received the revenue from the proposed sale that the resolution would have blocked.
